name: Attend a Sports Match
goal: Attend a sports match (soccer, basketball), find the stadium/arena, find the sector/seat, buy snacks, and talk to other fans about the team.
interactions: Asking for directions to a specific sector/seat
Buying snacks and drinks at the concession stand
Talking to other fans about the game and teams
learner_goals: Enter the stadium and find their seat
Engage in basic small talk with fans
Understand the current score/state of play
